firedManager: Bạn bị sa thải rồi, Quản lý!
whiteNight.blockNavigation.denyPresence: Do not deny me, for I am in front of your eyes.
whiteNight.blockExit: Do not fear, for I am with you. You cannot leave until I allow you to.
whiteNight.blockTime: Do not trust the time, for I will guide you.
plagueDoctor.apostle.1: 'And I tell you, you are #1 the apostle, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it.'
plagueDoctor.apostle.2: 'Tell us, when will this happen, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?'
plagueDoctor.apostle.3: 'Do you want us to call fire down from heaven to destroy them?'
plagueDoctor.apostle.4: '#3 the apostle and #4 the apostle to them he gave the name Boanerges, which means “sons of thunder."'
plagueDoctor.apostle.5: '#5 the apostle said, “Show us the Father and that will be enough for us.'
plagueDoctor.apostle.6: 'He saw a man named #6 the apostle. "Follow me,” he told him, and #6 got up and followed him.'
plagueDoctor.apostle.7: 'Now for some time a man named #7 the apostle had practiced sorcery and amazed all the people.'
plagueDoctor.apostle.8: Then #8 the apostle said to the rest of the disciples, “Let us also go, that we may die with him.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.9: Then #9 the apostle declared, “You are the Son of him, you are the king.”
plagueDoctor.apostle.10: Then #10 the apostle said, “But why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?”
plagueDoctor.apostle.11: 'From now on, let no one cause me trouble, for I bear on my body the marks of him.'
plagueDoctor.apostle.12: 'Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil'
blackForest.story.opening: A long time ago, in a warm and dense forest lived three happy birds.
blackForest.bigBird.arrives:
Big Bird, with his many eyes, watched over the forest to seek trespassers. 
Big Bird’s eyes can see very far, and things we can’t see.
blackForest.longBird.arrives:
Long Bird weighed the sins of creatures that enter the forest to keep peace. 
Long Bird’s scales could measure every sins, and were fair and just.
blackForest.smallBird.arrives: Little Bird decided to punish bad creatures with his beak.
blackForest.apocalypseBird.appears:
In chaotic cries of fear, somebody shouted.
“It’s the monster! Big terrible monster lives in the dark, black forest!”
blackForest.egg.bigEyes.destroyed: Far-sighted eyes of Big Bird have been blinded,
blackForest.egg.longArms.destroyed: A head that looked up to the cosmos has been lowered,
blackForest.egg.smallBeak.destroyed: And Little Bird’s mouth that devours everything has been shut,
blackForest.apocalypseBird.suppressed:
Three birds, now as one, looked around to find the monster but couldn’t find it.
There were no creatures, no sun and moon, and no monster. All that is left is just a bird, and the black forest.
